WITH overall_avg AS (
  SELECT AVG(f.rebtotal) as overall_avg_rebate
  FROM fees f
  INNER JOIN orders o ON f.orderslink = o.recordvault
),
group_stats AS (
  SELECT 
    f.orderslink,
    o.ordertune,
    AVG(f.rebtotal) as avg_rebate,
    AVG((f.rebrate - f.feerate) / f.feerate) as avg_relative_gap
  FROM fees f
  INNER JOIN orders o ON f.orderslink = o.recordvault
  GROUP BY f.orderslink, o.ordertune
)
SELECT 
  gs.orderslink,
  gs.ordertune,
  gs.avg_rebate,
  gs.avg_relative_gap,
  (gs.avg_rebate - oa.overall_avg_rebate) as margin_above_overall
FROM group_stats gs
CROSS JOIN overall_avg oa
WHERE gs.avg_rebate > oa.overall_avg_rebate
ORDER BY margin_above_overall DESC
LIMIT 10;

assumptions.assumption: All feerate values are non-zero and positive, avoiding division-by-zero in the gap ratio calculation
The 'average relative gap' means the arithmetic mean of individual gap ratios—AVG((rebrate - feerate) / feerate)—rather than the gap of aggregated rates
